_readme: Businesses sponsoring the band, shown on /sponsors. 'name' is the only required field. Add 'url' to link to their website, 'blurb' for a line about what they do, 'tier' to label them (Supporter, Featured, One-off), and 'logo' with a path to an image in /images if you have their logo.

_example.name: Corner Cafe
_example.blurb: Breakfast, lunch and the best flat white in town.

sponsors.name: Kernow Pages
sponsors.blurb: Websites for Cornish businesses — cafés, barbers, shops, trades and market stalls. Built this site for the boyz, and looks after it.

sponsors.name: Inkspires
sponsors.blurb: Embroidery and DTF printing with a fast turnaround and no minimum order. Based at St Austell Bay Business Park.
